title: Design System: Fahad Sajad — Video Editor Portfolio

headline.purpose: Every section h2 and item title (project/job/service), upright Alegreya Medium — not italic.

label.purpose: Mono functional labels — frame numbers, spec codes, nav tabs. Floor: 0.7rem.

shadows.name: light-bar-indicator
shadows.purpose: A tight, near-flat edge under the scroll-position light-bar window — sharp rather than diffuse.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rectangular CTA — transparent at rest, fills solid ink with paper text on hover/focus. Near-square corners, not a pill.
components.html: Review the Full Sheet
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.95rem 1.6rem; border: 1.5px solid #171717; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #171717; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #171717; color: #e9e7e1; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A contact-sheet frame — grayscale thumbnail that reveals color on hover, real frame number, SVG play badge.
components.html:
Project Title

One or two lines describing the project.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #e9e7e1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card__frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; background: #141412; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card__bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-size: cover; background-position: center; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05); transition: filter 0.6s, transform 0.7s; } .ds-card__frame:hover .ds-card__bg { filter: grayscale(0) contrast(1.05); transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-card__fnum { position: absolute; left: 0.6rem; top: 0.6rem; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #f2f0eb; } .ds-card__play { position: absolute; right: 0.7rem; bottom: 0.7rem; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.55); color: #f2f0eb; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-card__play svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-card__frame:hover .ds-card__play { opacity: 1; background: #93392a; border-color: #93392a; } .ds-card__info { padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1.3rem; border-top: 1px solid #d9d6ce; } .ds-card__info h3 { font-family: 'Alegreya', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; } .ds-card__info p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #676662; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: A spine-index nav link, prefixed by its real frame number, underline grows on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #676662; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; position: relative; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-tab::before { content: attr(data-frame); color: #b74a32; } .ds-nav-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -5px; left: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #171717; transition: width 0.3s; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #171717; } .ds-nav-tab:hover::after, .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a working contact sheet reviewed on a light table, not a cinematic-viewer skin. Every section is a numbered "sheet" in a proof book: frame numbers, spec codes, and a grease-pencil review mark carry real information the way they would on an editor's actual proof sheet, not as decoration borrowed from the genre. The system explicitly rejects the video-editor-portfolio default (REC dot, running timecode, film grain, tally-light red on black) that the incumbent design used before this redesign — that look is the confirmed visual anti-reference.

The palette stays cool and desaturated at rest — off-white and near-black rather than cream and brown, closer to a film lab or print-production sheet than a warm lifestyle brand; the single rust accent is rare and functional; the display type is a serif with real editorial character rather than a system sans or an overused "safe" display face, with italic reserved as a scarce expressive accent (hero, logotype, oversized numerals) rather than the default heading style. Depth is expressed through material contrast (paper vs. near-black frame-void) and thin, deliberate borders rather than soft shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, desaturated off-white light-table paper as the constant ground, never pure white, pure black, or warm cream
One accent color, used only where it marks something real (a link, an active state, a position indicator)
Serif display type carries the personality (italic reserved for the hero, logotype, and oversized numerals; upright Medium for all other headings/titles); mono type carries data
Frame/sheet numbering is real information architecture, not a decorative device
Flat at rest; sharp/thin borders over soft shadow; shadows only appear as a functional response to interaction, and stay tight rather than diffuse

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: The rust accent appears only where it marks something real — an active link, a hover state, a position indicator. It never fills a large decorative area and never appears twice in the same place for emphasis alone.

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in the system carries the same cool, desaturated undertone — never a warm cream/brown bias.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional mono label renders below 0.7rem (11.2px). 22 instances were found below this floor and fixed during the finish review — never reintroduce a sub-11px label size.

rules.name: The Scarce Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic Alegreya is reserved for the hero headline, the logotype/branding mark, and the oversized low-opacity sheet numerals. Every section heading and item title (project/job/service titles, the contact heading) renders upright Alegreya Medium instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows stay tight and functional (a real offset, never a diffuse glow), and thin borders/grid lines carry most of the structural weight instead.

dos: Do keep the rust accent (#b74a32) rare — active states, links, the light-bar indicator, the current nav tab. Nothing else.
Do keep every functional label at or above 0.7rem (11.2px).
Do vary each new section's opening composition rather than repeating the same kicker-then-heading template.
Do keep the work grid's card count a multiple of its column count (4 desktop / 2 tablet) so the last row never leaves a trailing empty void.
Do use real SVG line icons (stroke="currentColor", stroke-width: 1.5) for any icon.
Do keep corners sharp or barely rounded (0–3px) — a full pill/circle is reserved for conventional round affordances (play buttons, the loupe cursor), not decorative softness.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. The system is built around exactly one.
Don't use a diffuse/soft-glow shadow anywhere — keep any shadow tight, with a real small offset.
Don't use a Unicode glyph or emoji as an icon — draw it as an SVG matching the existing stroke weight.
Don't set the hero headline, logotype, or oversized sheet numerals upright — italic is load-bearing there. Don't set a section heading or item title italic — that's the opposite mistake.
Don't reintroduce timecode, REC-dot, film-grain, or scrubber-as-video-player motifs — that is the explicitly rejected prior world.
Don't let the neutrals drift warm (cream/brown) — the system was deliberately corrected away from that toward a cool, desaturated ground.
